### Added

- **The dashboard says when a server stops answering.** Before, the app kept showing the last monitors it got, all green, with nothing to say they were out of date. Now a banner shows under the app bar, 'Lost connection to \<server>. Reconnecting…', or 'Cannot connect to \<server>' if it couldn't reach it at all. It shows how long ago the last update came in when there is one, and goes away on its own when the server answers again.
- With several servers aggregated, each lost server gets its own line in the banner.
- **In real-time mode, the always-on notification says it too**: 'Lost connection to \<server>' with the time of the last update, or 'Lost connection to 2 of 3 servers', for the servers real-time mode is watching. It goes back to 'Watching…' once they answer. Outside
